units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 241:6">Yalk. Ex. 241</cite> <he>קִינְטוּרוֹ באז</he> his (Moses’) remonstrance is introduced with <he>אָז</he> (<cite ref="Exodus 5:23">Ex. V, 23</cite>).—Pl. <he>קִינְטוּרִין</he>, <cite ref="S01035"><he>קִנְ׳</he></cite>. Pesik. Shimʿu, p. 117ᵇ <he>שמעו דברי תוכחות … דברי ק׳</he> listen to the words of rebuke, that you may not have to hear words of reproach. Ib. <he>דברים ק׳</he> (insert <he>של</he> or read: <he>דברי</he>) reproachful words, opp. <he>נִחוּמִים</he>; (Ar. a.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 265:1">Yalk. Jer. 265</cite> <he>קִנְתּוּרִין</he>). Koh. R. beg. <he>ע״י שהיה נבואתן דברי קַנְתְּרִין</he> because their prophecy contained reproaches; a. e.—[Pesik. R., addit. s. 2 (ed. Fr. p. 197ᵃ) <he>הקנטורים</he>, v. <cite ref="S00833"><he>קִטְרוֹן</he> II</cite>.]
